title: Blood glucose
text: Follow the meter's instructions exactly: clean dry hands, an adequate blood drop, a current test strip, and the control check the maker requires.

Below 70 mg/dL scores watch and below 54 scores critical; 200 or above scores watch and 250 or above scores critical. Low blood sugar with confusion, shaking or sweating needs fast sugar and the crew medical officer at once.
